unavailable: Passwords needs lord-vault, the vault helper, and it is not installed.
login.hint: What apps keep in the session keyring: it opens by itself when you log in with your password. Mail, Settings → Network and Linux apps (Secret Service) store here.
list.more: and {count} more: search to find them
unlock.title: Passwords is locked
unlock.subtitle: Your passwords are encrypted on this computer. Unlock to see them.
unlock.noKeyfile: No key file chosen (for example, on a USB stick)
unlock.unreadable: The vault file can't be read: it may be damaged. The previous copy is next to it, as .bak.
create.title: Welcome to Passwords
create.subtitle: A vault encrypted with XChaCha20-Poly1305 and Argon2id, in a single file you can copy and carry on a USB stick. Choose how it unlocks.
create.short: The password must have at least 8 characters.
create.needKeyPath: Choose where to save the key file.
create.keyWhere: Where to save the key file (a USB stick)
create.local: Nothing leaves this computer: Passwords doesn't use the network.
create.about.password: One password you remember. If you forget it, only the recovery key is left.
create.about.fido: A USB security key (YubiKey, SoloKey, Nitrokey…) with FIDO2 hmac-secret: it must be plugged in and touched to unlock.
create.about.keyfile: A file with 64 random bytes, for example on a USB stick: without the file it won't open. Keep a copy.
create.about.passkey: Two factors: the password and the key file. Both are needed.
recovery.title: Your recovery key
recovery.body: If you lose the password, the security key or the key file, this key opens the vault. Print it or keep it away from this computer: nobody else can recover it.
recovery.confirm: I printed it or saved it somewhere safe
recovery.printBody: This key opens your Passwords vault if you lose the master password, the security key or the key file. Keep it somewhere safe.
fido.insert: Plug in the security key. When it blinks, touch it.
fido.insertCreate: Plug in the security key: a new credential is created (it asks for two touches).
edit.title: Title
edit.titlePh: For example, Bank or my email
rotate.label: Remind me to change the password
rotate.due: Change it every {days} days: {left} days left.
rotate.overdue: Change it every {days} days: overdue by {ago} days.
totp.notOtp: The QR is not a 2FA code (otpauth://).
wifi.scan: Scan it with your phone to join
crypto.warning: The seed phrase gives full control of the wallet. Never type it into a website or give it to anyone: no support team will ever ask for it.
att.title: Attachments
trash.inTrash: This item is in the Trash.
gen.title: Password generator
gen.wordsHint: Words from the EFF list (7776): 12.9 bits each.
report.title: Security
report.weakHint: Short, predictable or among the most used: easy to guess.
report.reusedHint: If one site leaks it, it opens the others.
report.oldHint: Past their change reminder (or unchanged for over a year).
report.breachedHint: Compared offline with the 10,000 most common passwords from public breaches.
report.hibpUsing: Compared with the local list of breached passwords you chose (offline).
report.offline: The report runs on this computer, inside the sandboxed helper: no password leaves or is looked up online.
report.commonHint: This password appears in breach lists: choose another.
codes.empty: No 2FA codes yet. Add one to an item: paste the otpauth:// link or choose the QR image.
set.title: Vault settings
set.unlockHint: Each way to unlock keeps the vault key wrapped separately: they can be added and removed without re-encrypting everything.
set.passkeyWarn: The password alone will no longer open the vault: the key file will also be needed.
set.autolockHint: It also locks when you lock the screen (❖L) and when switching users.
set.clipHint: What you copy from Passwords is marked secret: it stays out of the clipboard history and out of Linux apps' clipboard managers.
set.measured: For ~0.7 s: {m} MiB and {t} passes (≈{ms} ms)
set.calibrateHint: It is tuned automatically when the vault or an unlock method is created; changing the password measures again.
set.memory: Protected memory in lord-vault: {kb} KB in use, {locked} KB pinned (no swap, no dumps).
imp.title: Import passwords
imp.formats: Password databases (.kdbx) and exports from other password managers (JSON or CSV), browser CSV exports (Title, URL, Username, Password) and Passwords copies (.lvault).
imp.kdbxHint: Read with our own reader, inside the sandboxed helper: KDBX 4 (Argon2, AES or ChaCha20) and KDBX 3.1.
exp.title: Export
exp.vaultHint: A copy of the vault, encrypted like the original: it opens with the same methods as always. Good for backups or another computer.
exp.csvWarning: The CSV stores ALL your passwords as unencrypted text. Anyone who sees the file sees them. Delete it as soon as you're done and never upload it anywhere.
exp.csvConfirm: I understand the risk: export unencrypted
cats.name: Name
cats.fieldsHint: If you add fields, new items in this category use them instead of the template's.
cats.inUse: There are items in this category: move them before deleting it.
picker.name: File name
keyring.title: An app wants to use the session keyring
keyring.body: The keyring is locked. Type your login password to unlock it.
err.bad-key: Wrong password, security key or key file.
err.corrupt: The file is damaged or was tampered with: it doesn't authenticate.
err.no-device: No security key is plugged in.
err.keyfile-read: The key file couldn't be read.
err.keyfile-short: That file is too small to be a key file.
err.keyfile-write: The key file couldn't be written.
err.unknown-format: I don't recognize the file format.
err.bad-password: The database password or key file is wrong.
err.encrypted-export: It's an encrypted export: export it again without encryption (JSON).
err.no-qr: I couldn't find a QR code in the image.
err.not-an-image: It's not a PNG or JPEG image.
err.last-slot: It's the last way to unlock: add another before removing it.
err.busy: Another security-key operation is in progress.
err.file: That file can't be used (does it exist already, or is it outside your folder?).
err.fido-timeout: Nobody touched the key in time.
err.fido-pin-required: The key has a PIN: type it.
err.fido-pin-blocked: The key blocked its PIN after too many attempts.
err.fido-no-credential: This is not the registered key.
err.fido-no-hmac: This key has no hmac-secret (U2F only): it can't be used for encryption.
err.fido-denied: Permission to use the key was denied.
err.unavailable: The vault helper is not available.
err.bad-keyfile: The database key file is not valid.
autofill.title: Fill from Passwords
autofill.none: Nothing saved for this (or Passwords is locked).
saveOffer.ask: Save the password for {title} in Passwords?
saveOffer.locked: Passwords is locked. Unlock it, then Save.
clip.replaced: Something else replaced the clipboard right away: {what} is no longer there. Another app or a machine sharing its clipboard may be taking it.
pickHint: Its fields, codes and notes appear here.
emptyHint: Add your first item with + or import them from another password manager (File → Import).
list.sortHint: Sort by name or by the last change
err.fido-restricted: USB security keys are blocked for Passwords by a restriction in Privacy → App network access.
polkit.title: {app} asks for administrator rights
polkit.typeHere: Type the password on this computer's keyboard and press Enter.
polkit.noKeyboard: This needs a keyboard attached to this computer. It can't be typed from a remote screen or the on-screen keyboard.
polkit.wrong: That password didn't work. Try again.
